$comment: Typed handoff contract for the Aristotle -> Optimus boundary (aristotle-deconstructor/SKILL.md 'Handoff contracts'). Field names map to the aristotle-deconstructor agent's phases: aristotelian_move is Phase 5 (THE ARISTOTELIAN MOVE), assumptions_stripped is Phase 1 (ASSUMPTION AUTOPSY), bedrock_truths is Phase 2 (IRREDUCIBLE TRUTHS — the bedrock the agent rebuilds from). Only this object crosses the boundary; the full Phase 1-4 analysis and any implementation specifics are stripped per the SKILL.md handoff rules.

aristotelian_move.$comment: The single highest-leverage action, 1-2 sentences. Optimus references it as the Problem Summary source and must not re-litigate it.

assumptions_stripped.$comment: Inherited assumptions identified in the Assumption Autopsy and removed from the framing — recorded so Optimus does not reintroduce them.

bedrock_truths.$comment: The irreducible first principles that survive Phase 2 — the foundation the plan must be built from.

constraints.$comment: Hard constraints on the solution space, including any user modifications or constraints stated at the approval gates.
